name: drone-light-painter
description: Cross-platform desktop app for designing drone light-painting patterns and exporting ArduPilot Lua scripts
author: Drone Light Painter

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:main && electron . --dev"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build:main && electron-builder
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:main && electron .
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:main && electron tests/electron-smoke.cjs
